decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch line is close to the core seasonal offer and was featured on the home page, so it likely remains a steady seller despite not being observed recently.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is a staple of this craft tradition and fits the established business, so keeping it makes sense even though it has had little recent visibility.
The motif platform was an accessory to the electronic music box system that was withdrawn in 2019, so it lacks a supporting product and its resources are better used in the core business.
